answer:
Setup. Interchanging two address chunks of width e = m^k on a volume V uses a fixed linear exchange network with W wires, and the rows are dealt cyclically into W role streams, each of volume V/W. Each edge i of the network carries a Pogotos shear by a matrix A_i, and a shear of rank r costs exactly r interchanges of fields of width e/m, each of which is a recursive call at the smaller parameter e/m on the stream. So one call at width e makes s = sum of the edge ranks smaller calls, each on a stream of volume V/W.

Recurrence. Per unit volume, the cost F_k at width m^k satisfies F_k <= c F_{k-1} + O(1) with c = s/W, because the node's own splitting, gates and triangular work is O(V). Unrolling over k = log_m e levels gives a per-unit-volume cost of about c^k = e^{log_m c}. The exponent is log_m c = log_m(s/W), and this is a genuine power saving exactly when the exponent is below 1, i.e. when c < m, i.e. when s < Wm. Then any fixed tau with c < m^tau < m gives total cost O(V e^tau), with tau < 1.

Why the hinge is strict. If s = Wm, then c = m, the exponent is 1, and the total is proportional to V e, so there is no saving. Writing c = m(1 - eta), with eta the relative deficit (Wm - s)/(Wm), the exponent is 1 + log_m(1 - eta), which is below 1 exactly when eta > 0. The whole saving is therefore the gap between s and Wm.

Where the inequality comes from. Pukezad attaches to each wire a nested subspace of an m-dimensional label space (m = h^3 = 10^6), so each edge's rank is its absolute change in label dimension. Summing over the wires, the absolute changes give Wm - 2N, plus 2L for the dimensions lost on decreasing edges (L the total loss), and the sign at each bit source adds N, so s_b = Wm - (N - 2L_b). The complex network gives s_c = Wm - (2N - 2L_c). Since L_b/N = 100/539 < 1/2 and L_c/N = 101/539 < 1/2, both deficits are positive and s < Wm strictly. The bit deficit relative to Wm is about 1.5 x 10^-11, which is tiny but positive, so there is a fixed tau < 1 above the exponent (the page picks tau = 1 - 2^-50).

Caveat. I checked the arithmetic of L/N, the deficit and the relative deficit, but I did not verify each label step of the Pukezad dimension table; I took that bookkeeping and the complex count (stated on Letenat) largely on the page's word.

key_idea.statement: Each level of the recursion multiplies the cost per unit volume by s/W, so after log_m f levels the cost grows as f^(log_m(s/W)), a genuine power saving exactly when s/W < m, that is, when s < Wm.

reason: Answered, with moderate confidence. I followed the recurrence F_k <= c F_{k-1} + O(1), the unrolling into e^{log_m c}, and the exponent arithmetic in full, and I checked the numbers L/N = 100/539 and the bit and complex relative deficits. Less certain: the Pukezad label-dimension bookkeeping that gives s = Wm - (N - 2L), which I accepted largely on the page's word, and the claim that every route changes all m dimensions, which is asserted rather than shown. I opened 9 of the 15 allowed pages (pid, rut, dol, ber, kep, nob, vez, zaz, mot).
